mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, express_id AS expressId, exception_type AS exceptionType, description AS description, image_url AS imageUrl, reporter_id AS reporterId, handler_id AS handlerId, handle_status AS handleStatus, handle_remark AS handleRemark, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(handle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS handleTime, DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM express_exception WHERE express_id = #{expressId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM express_exception WHERE handle_status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')

SELECT x.id AS id, x.express_id AS expressId, e.express_no AS expressNo, e.receiver_name AS receiverName, e.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, e.status AS expressStatus, x.exception_type AS exceptionType, x.description AS description, x.image_url AS imageUrl, x.reporter_id AS reporterId, ru.real_name AS reporterName, x.handler_id AS handlerId, hu.real_name AS handlerName, x.handle_status AS handleStatus, x.handle_remark AS handleRemark, DATE_FORMAT(x.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(x.handle_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS handleTime, DATE_FORMAT(x.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM express_exception x LEFT JOIN express e ON e.id = x.express_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = x.reporter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user hu ON hu.id = x.handler_id WHERE x.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO express_exception ( express_id, exception_type, description, image_url, reporter_id, handler_id, handle_status, handle_remark, create_time, handle_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{expressId}, #{exceptionType}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{reporterId}, #{handlerId}, #{handleStatus}, #{handleRemark}, NOW(), #{handleTime}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE express_exception SET handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_status = #{handleStatus}, handle_remark = #{handleRemark}, handle_time = #{handleTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthCount, COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM express_exception WHERE reporter_id = #{userId}
